dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Thank goodness Liyue is still safe and sound...

choices.text: Ganyu, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: It's all thanks to you that we managed to get through this crisis.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Phew... In any case, I'm glad everyone is safe.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Speaking of which, how are you holding up? Any tiredness or pain?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: I'm glad... When Keqing and I heard that Director Hu had to carry you to Bubu Pharmacy — that you were unconscious — we rushed over there immediately.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Thankfully, Baizhu reassured us it was just exhaustion. It was a huge relief.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Still, you should be careful. If you feel unwell over the next few days, come find me, and I'll take you to see Cloud Retainer.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: She may not be known for her skill in medicine, but the adepti are knowledgeable and resourceful in all kinds of fields, so I'm sure she can help!
